# Context Before Content {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

Stop asking. Start interrogating.

## The Wrong Way {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="workflow" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.2em;"}
Open AI → Type question → Hope for the best
:::

. . .

::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
"Write a report on the Saudi Fintech market."

→ Generic, Wikipedia-style summary from 2021.
:::

## The Right Way {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="workflow" style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.2em;"}
Upload source → Give instructions → Get grounded results
:::

. . .

::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**Upload** the [SAMA Financial Sector Report](https://www.sama.gov.sa/en-US/Documents/Financial_Sector_Development_Program_Annual_Report-2023-EN.pdf) → "Based *only* on this report, summarize..."

→ Specific, citation-backed analysis an expert would trust.
:::

## The "Context First" Rule

::: {.incremental}
1. **Don't ask** — "What are the trends in tourism?"
2. **Upload** — *[Ministry of Tourism - Hospitality Investor Report](https://cdn.mt.gov.sa/files/Hospitality-Investor.pdf)*
3. **Instruct** — "Based *only* on the uploaded report, summarize visitor adoption rates for Red Sea vs. AlUla."
:::

. . .

::: {.callout-important}
## The Rule
No upload = no trust. Context comes **before** content.
:::

# The Trust Layer {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #9B8EC0)"}

The antidote to hallucinations

## Why You Need a Trust Layer {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="trust"}
Hallucinations happen when AI **doesn't know** the answer but **tries to please you** by guessing.
:::

. . .

The **Trust Layer** forces AI to use *your sources* as its only truth.

## Why This Matters for Saudi Professionals

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
**Government**

You cannot quote a "Vision 2030 target" that doesn't exist.
:::
:::
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
**Legal**

Citations must point to actual articles in the Labor Law.
:::
:::
:::
::: {.column width="33%"}
::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #FF7A5C;"}
**Corporate**

Market numbers must match Tadawul disclosures, not internet estimates.
:::
:::
:::
::::

## The Golden Rule

::: {style="background: #1C355E; color: #ffffff; padding: 1.5em; border-radius: 12px; text-align: center; font-size: 1.3em;"}
**If it doesn't have a citation, it didn't happen.**
:::

# Your Research Toolkit {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #1C355E, #00C9A7)"}

3 tools, 3 superpowers

## Tool A: NotebookLM (Google) {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="tool-a" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7;"}
**Best for:** Deep reading of massive documents (50+ pages)

**Superpower:** Creates a "Source Guide" solely from *your* documents — no internet hallucinations.
:::

## NotebookLM — Saudi Scenario {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="tool-a" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 0.8em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7; font-size: 0.85em;"}
**Best for:** Deep reading of massive documents (50+ pages)
:::

**Scenario:** Petrochemicals sustainability benchmarking

::: {.incremental}
- **Upload** 5 competitor sustainability reports (Dow, BASF, etc.)
- **Prompt:** "Compare Scope 3 Emission targets across all 5 companies vs. our draft policy. Create a gap table."
- **Bonus:** Generate an Audio Overview to listen on the drive to KAFD
:::

## Tool B: Deep Research {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="tool-b" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0;"}
**Best for:** Real-time synthesis of the live web

**Superpower:** Reads 20–30 websites in seconds and **footnotes every sentence**.
:::

::: {style="font-size: 0.8em; color: #666;"}
Perplexity / ChatGPT Pro / Google Gemini
:::

## Deep Research — Saudi Scenario {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="tool-b" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 0.8em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #9B8EC0; font-size: 0.85em;"}
**Best for:** Real-time synthesis of the live web
:::

**Scenario:** Tourism & Hospitality intelligence

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px;"}
**Prompt:** "Find the top 5 complaints in tourist reviews for 5-star Riyadh hotels during Riyadh Season 2024. Group by category. Cite specific review sources."
:::
:::

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
**Result:** "30% cited 'Valet Parking Delays' (Source: Booking.com, Review #42)" — *actionable intel, not fluff.*
:::



## Choosing the Right Tool

| Need | Tool | Why |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Analyze a 100-page PDF | **NotebookLM** | Grounded in your docs only |
| Live market intelligence | **Deep Research** | Real-time web with citations |


# Activity {.sdaia-dark background-gradient="linear-gradient(135deg, #FF7A5C, #1C355E)"}

The 10-Hour Research Task in 10 Minutes

## The Scenario {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="scenario" style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1.2em; border-radius: 12px;"}
It's **10:00 AM**. Your Department Head sends a **40-page PDF** — *"Global Trends in Green Hydrogen 2025"*.

Board meeting at **11:00 AM**. They need a **1-page Executive Summary**.
:::

. . .

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="text-align: center; color: #FF7A5C; font-weight: bold;"}
Old way: 2+ hours

Read → Highlight → Panic-type
:::
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
::: {style="text-align: center; color: #00C9A7; font-weight: bold;"}
Your way: 10 minutes

Upload → Instruct → Verify
:::
:::
::::

## Step 1: Upload {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="steps"}
Open **NotebookLM** (or Claude/ChatGPT with file upload)
:::

Drag and drop the PDF.

. . .

::: {.callout-note}
## Use the [IEA Global Hydrogen Review 2024](https://www.iea.org/reports/global-hydrogen-review-2024)
100+ pages — perfect for demonstrating the power of grounded research.
:::

## Step 2: Interrogate {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="steps"}
Give the AI a precise, constrained prompt:
:::

::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00C9A7; font-size: 0.85em;"}
"Act as a Strategy Consultant for a Saudi Energy company.

Based *strictly* on this report, outline the 3 biggest opportunities and 3 biggest risks for our market.

If the information is not in the report, state 'Not found in source.' DO NOT hallucinate.

Include page references for every point.

Conclude with a 'Recommended Stance' for the board meeting."
:::

## Step 3: Verify & Deliver {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="steps"}
Polish and share your output:
:::

::: {.incremental}
1. **Verify citations** — click the page references, check the source text
2. **Edit for tone** — match your company's board style
3. **Optional flex** — generate an Audio Overview and send the link
:::

## Step 4: The Action (Closing the Loop) {auto-animate=true}

::: {data-id="steps"}
Now that you have the facts, **Delegation** kicks in.
:::

::: {style="background: #f7f9fc; padding: 1em; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 0.85em;"}
"Based on this summary, draft a high-priority email to my Director, Dr. Ahmed.

- **Context:** He is heading into a ministry meeting.
- **Task:** Warn him about the 'Euro-Deal' risks we found.
- **Constraint:** Use 'Saudi Executive' tone. Bullet points only."
:::

Pick the Right Tool

::: {.fragment .fade-in}
::: {.callout-tip}
## Deep Research (Perplexity / Gemini)
Live web access. NotebookLM can't do this — it only reads your docs.
:::
:::



## Key Takeaways {.sdaia-dark background-color="#1C355E"}

::: {.incremental}
1. **Context before content** — never start with a blank prompt
2. **Build a Trust Layer** — upload your sources, constrain the AI
3. **No citation = didn't happen** — demand page references
4. **Right tool, right job** — NotebookLM / Deep Research
5. **10 minutes, not 10 hours** — upload, interrogate, verify
:::
